RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the appointed candidate are women, making a claim of sex-based discrimination factually and legally unsupported. Bringing up the panel’s gender composition would appear unfounded and could severely damage your professional credibility and internal relationships.

For a laboratory head role, selection panels frequently weigh broad leadership experience, formal management training, and operational scope more heavily than advanced academic research credentials (like a PhD). The decision almost certainly reflects a preference for administrative experience rather than bias. 

Send a polite, professional follow-up regarding your feedback request. Keep the focus entirely on understanding which leadership competencies you can develop to strengthen your candidacy for future executive roles.
